content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with a personal task list","i_want":"to mark a task as Completed","so_that":"I can record that the task is finished","business_description":"The user can change the status of an existing task to Completed. The backend stores the new status and the time of the change. The frontend shows the new status only after the backend confirms the change. The status change endpoint is limited to Completed in this story; see the open question in the edge cases.","business_value":"Users can record finished work in the task list without editing the whole task, and the stored status and dates reflect what the backend accepted.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"A task with status Open exists","when":"The user marks the task as Completed and the backend accepts the request","then":"The backend stores the status Completed, sets the Completion Date to the time of the change, and sets the Last Updated Date to the same time"},{"given":"A task with status Open exists and the status change request has been sent but the backend has not responded","when":"The task list is displayed","then":"The task row shows status Open and no success message is shown"},{"given":"A status change request for an existing task has been accepted by the backend","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The task row shows status Completed and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"A status change request for an existing task fails in the backend with an internal server or database error","when":"The frontend receives the failure response","then":"The task row still shows the previous status, no Completion Date change is shown, and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"No task exists with the ID in the status change request","when":"The backend processes the request","then":"The backend returns a task not found error and no stored task is changed"},{"given":"A status change request has no status value","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with a missing mandatory field error and the stored task is unchanged"},{"given":"A status change request has a status value other than Completed","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with an invalid input error and the stored status, Completion Date and Last Updated Date are unchanged"}],"edge_cases":["Open question for the team: the PRD requires a status change endpoint but does not say which status values it accepts. This story accepts only Completed; allowing Open or In Progress would change the validation rule and must be decided before extending it.","Open question: the PRD does not say what happens when a task that is already Completed receives another Completed request.
